meals.emptyMealDesc: Get a weekly meal plan with local Ethiopian, budget-friendly foods for your goal
meals.calendarFileNote: Covers 1 year from download — every day of the week, every meal time. Re-download when the year ends to extend. Same file on all platforms.
meals.calendarFileNoteSamsung: Optimized for Samsung Calendar: one event per day (Samsung often ignores repeating rules). Covers 1 year — all 7 weekdays, every meal. Re-download when the year ends.
meals.inAppNotRecommended: In-app reminders only work while FitTrack Pro is open. Calendar import is recommended for locked-screen alerts.

android.label: Samsung (Android)
android.hint: Use Samsung Calendar on Galaxy phones — this file is built for Samsung (not Google Calendar repeat rules).
steps: Open My Files or Downloads → tap fittrack-meal-reminders.ics.
When asked which app, choose Samsung Calendar (not Google Calendar) → Import / Add all events.
In Samsung Calendar: ☰ → Manage calendars → turn on the imported calendar if events are hidden.
Settings → Apps → Samsung Calendar → Notifications → allow alerts and reminders.
No Samsung Calendar option? Open Samsung Calendar → ☰ → Import → pick the .ics file from Downloads.

iphone.label: iPhone
iphone.hint: Import into the built-in Calendar app on iOS.
steps: Tap Download calendar file (.ics) above (or open from Files after download).
Tap the file → Add All when Apple Calendar offers to subscribe or import.
Confirm each meal time appears in Calendar.
Settings → Notifications → Calendar → allow alerts and time-sensitive if needed.

windows.label: Windows
windows.hint: Import into Outlook or the Windows Calendar app.
steps: Tap Download calendar file (.ics) above and save the file.
Open Outlook → File → Open & Export → Import/Export → Import an iCalendar (.ics) file.
Or double-click the file and choose Windows Calendar / Outlook.
Enable notifications for Calendar or Outlook in Windows Settings.

other.label: Other
other.hint: Any app that imports standard .ics calendar files (Google, Apple, Outlook, Thunderbird, etc.).
steps: Download the .ics file using the button above.
Open the file with your preferred calendar application.
Import or subscribe to all events when prompted.
Turn on notifications for that calendar app in your system settings.
